description: WRITES a comment on a board as the person signed in: on a card (card_id), a group (group_id), a spot (x and y) or the whole board (none). For words in a doc give its card_id and quote (page_id if on more than one page). reply_to replies in that thread. Inside docs and notes only an editor writes. Everyone who can open the board sees it: write as the person would.

page_id.description: The doc page the quoted words are on

quote.description: Words in the doc named by card_id, as the doc has them

name: add_comment
title: Add comment
